name: RELIANCE, INC.
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat in commodity metals distribution: largest North American service-center network (~310 locations) with scale purchasing, local availability and value-added processing on ~49% of orders, plus extreme customer/product diversification and a proven roll-up — but the product is a commodity with low switching costs, pricing power belongs to the metals market and tariff policy rather than the company, and filed OE fell from $1,711,500,000 (2022) to $446,900,000 (2025) as prices normalized. Moat 5 gives CAP 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 4.9%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 8.45 vs 3-yr median 16.75 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Quality cyclical metals distributor, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $406.67 on any defensible base (weighted IRR 5.64% on TTM base $10.69/sh, 7.39% on median base $16.75/sh; weighted IV@15% $98.82 / $154.94); clears 15% only at roughly $99-$155.
moat_for: Largest North American metals service-center network (~310 locations) — scale purchasing and geographic breadth
Value-added processing on ~49% of orders adds service stickiness beyond commodity metal
Extreme diversification: 125,000+ customers, 100,000+ products, many end markets
Proven roll-up operator (76 acquisitions since 1994 IPO) in a fragmented industry
Disciplined capital returns: share count shrinking 4.91%/yr, modest net debt
moat_against: Commodity product: no IP or brand pricing power; customers can dual-source regionally
Earnings are a pass-through of metals prices and industrial volumes; LIFO expense rises with prices
Tariff/Section 232 pricing support is a policy variable that can reverse
Current volume tailwind includes a finite U.S. border wall project
Returns collapse in downcycles: OE total fell 2022 $1,711,500,000 to 2025 $446,900,000
